sv.title: Grov misshandel i lägenhet
sv.summary: Två personer greps i Eslöv under natten, misstänkta för att ha misshandlat en tredje person i en lägenhet.

en.title: Aggravated assault in apartment
en.summary: Two people were arrested in Eslöv during the night, suspected of having assaulted a third person in an apartment.
